title: Henry Allen's band, Joe Howell and August Russo
summary: Williams followed Henry Allen's funeral band and names Joe Howell and August Russo as players with it.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: You can see Red Island up there, huh?
Well I, Red Island wasn't living very far from my cousin of mine up in the Bronx. But I didn't see him. You don't know his father. I knew him. Allen. Henry Allen. I knew old man Allen.
I know Henry Allen. I used to follow his generals.
He had some tough music. I never used to play with him but I used to hear him.
This fellow, August Russo, who played trombone, he used to do a real good alto player. He quit the alto player and got on the trombone.
That must be the upright alto you're talking about, not the saxophone.
Upright, upright alto. Joe Howell, he used to play trumpet with Allen too.
He played several instruments, didn't he?
Only two I know he played. Trumpet and the bass. Well did he play string bass or tuba?
No, tuba. Who all did he play with on tuba? Who? Joe Howell. Well the only one I know he played with.
He played a while with Errico and from there he got in the WP band. That's all the band I've been playing.
He must have been a good trumpet player. He played with a lot of bands.
Yeah, he was a good reader too.
